description: This file defines classes and functions for audit trail logging in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including rules, logs, log lines, and a proxy for object method call interception.

classes.name: audittrail_rule
classes.description: Defines audit rules for models, including subscribing and unsubscribing rules, with associated actions.

classes.name: audittrail_log
classes.description: Represents audit log entries recording user actions on models.

classes.name: audittrail_log_line
classes.description: Represents individual field change lines within an audit log entry.

classes.name: audittrail_objects_proxy
classes.description: Proxy class intercepting object method calls to log read/write/create/unlink actions based on rules.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a view log action and updates rule state to subscribed.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes view log actions and resets rule state to draft.

methods.name: get_value_text
methods.description: Retrieves human-readable text for field values, especially for relational fields.

methods.name: create_log_line
methods.description: Creates log line records for field changes.

methods.name: log_fct
methods.description: Logs create, write, read, and unlink actions by capturing old/new values.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Intercepts method calls on models to apply audit rules and log actions accordingly.
